integration: Read the explicit HULLSCOPE_YACHT_PREVIEW=1 Vite plugin path, generated preview release, production release snapshot and stage.ts release writer.
Started the local Vite server with HULLSCOPE_YACHT_PREVIEW=1, verified a local yacht manifest response, and ran the existing browser discovery flow against that server.
Recomputed seed dispositions read-only from the source seed table and disposition files, then checked the generated seed-audit artifact and selected release scope.
validation: Browser integration test passed: tests/browser/yachts.spec.ts yacht discovery, including 21 yacht cards (20 preview vessels plus preserved Octopus) and 10 Princess / 10 Sunseeker preview cards.
method.visualBoundary: This is an integration/release audit only. It does not approve geometry, materials, room quality or publication; those remain the explicit VIS-001/VIS-002/VIS-003 hold from audit 14.
method.pendingBlenderRebuild: No pending Blender MCP rebuild was treated as complete. This audit makes no claim that unverified geometry edits are present in masters.

localDevPath.releaseSwap: Preview mode replaces src/data/yachts/release.json with .tools/yachts/preview/release.json only for the local serve path.

productionRelease.note: .pages/Hullscope/release.json is only the existing site build marker; it is not a yacht dataset release marker.

blockers.title: Reference-faithful exterior geometry remains unproven
blockers.note: Audit 14 found visible model signatures in refreshed sets, but simplified procedural hull, glazing, roofline and deck geometry still fails the distinctive-features gate.

blockers.title: Room interiors remain blockout-level
blockers.note: The shared two-side-wall cutaway rule is covered, but room shells, joinery, fixtures, supports, occlusion and framing remain insufficient.

blockers.title: Materials remain visually insufficient
blockers.note: Brand palette separation and texture payloads exist, but rendered gelcoat, glazing, teak and interiors still read as low-detail color blocks.

verdict.summary: The explicit local preview path is correctly isolated and serves exactly the 20-vessel preview catalog, reconciliation is resolved, and staging now carries unresolvedSeedRows. The production yacht release remains empty and unpromoted. Visual approval remains blocked by VIS-001, VIS-002 and VIS-003.
